scientific_status: Demo-only; not validated, normed, difficulty-matched, or approved for clinical use.

composition_strategy.orr: Empty-room backplates and transparent object layers are composed deterministically in HTML/CSS.
composition_strategy.mdt_os: Base and comparison frames reuse the same generated pixels; repeat trials are exact and lure changes are deterministic overlays or transforms.
composition_strategy.csr: Independent photographic scenes are used as old items and new recognition foils.
